page.title: Shadow replay
page.intro: Replay recorded sessions against another model. Tools are answered from the recording and never run. This is a comparison, not a benchmark result.

settings.toggle: Allow shadow replay for this organization
settings.confirm: Recorded sessions, cleaned of keys and personal data, will be sent to the model you pick, through your own model key. Tools are never run.
settings.off: Shadow replay is off. Ask an org admin to turn it on.
settings.adminOnly: Only an admin can change this.

form.title: New replay
form.sourceHint: A Bifrost source of your inbox
form.sourceNone: Your inbox has no Bifrost source yet. Add one on the Inbox page first.
form.modeFixed: Same inputs, one step at a time
form.modeTrajectory: Let the new model carry on
form.modeFixedHelp: Each step gets the recorded inputs, so every answer is compared on equal terms.
form.modeTrajectoryHelp: The new model keeps going from its own answers instead of the recorded ones.
form.capHint: In US dollars, shared by the new model and the judge.
form.confirmCost: I understand this replay makes paid model calls up to the spending cap
form.started: Replay started. It shows below when it is done.
